## Arrow aliases and string choices

```python
# Copyright 2025, 2026 Query Farm LLC - https://query.farm

"""Explicit Arrow encodings shared by the proposed reporting contracts."""

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Annotated

import pyarrow as pa
from vgi_rpc import ArrowType

Instant = Annotated[datetime, ArrowType(pa.timestamp("us", "UTC"))]
"""An aware datetime, encoded as UTC microseconds on the wire."""

Json = str
"""One JSON value encoded as text; semantic validation belongs to the worker."""

SchemaIpc = Annotated[pa.Schema, ArrowType(pa.binary())]
"""An Arrow schema serialized as one IPC schema message."""

RowIpc = Annotated[pa.RecordBatch, ArrowType(pa.binary())]
"""A one-row batch serialized with its schema as a complete IPC stream."""


def non_null_list(item: pa.DataType) -> ArrowType:
    """Declare a list whose elements cannot be null, independent of Arrow defaults."""
    return ArrowType(pa.list_(pa.field("item", item, nullable=False)))
```

# Copyright 2025, 2026 Query Farm LLC - https://query.farm

"""Known string choices, encoded as utf8 rather than dictionary-encoded Enum.

Literal annotations assist callers and reviewers. Workers enforce allowed input
values; clients must still tolerate unknown output values from newer workers.
Plain strings are retained for explicitly open vendor kinds and action hints.
"""

from typing import Annotated, Literal

import pyarrow as pa
from vgi_rpc import ArrowType

ExecutionState = Annotated[Literal["ready", "needs_credentials", "unavailable"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
CredentialState = Annotated[Literal["ok", "expiring", "expired", "missing"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
LimitUnit = Annotated[Literal["bytes", "rows", "seconds", "count", "utf8_bytes"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
ParameterType = Annotated[
    Literal["text", "number", "date", "boolean", "select", "multi_select", "date_range"], ArrowType(pa.string())
]
ParamKind = Annotated[Literal["literal", "relative"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
Severity = Annotated[Literal["info", "warning", "critical"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
DeliveryStatus = Annotated[Literal["accepted", "refused", "failed", "unknown"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
TriggerKind = Annotated[Literal["cron", "once"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
EffectOutcome = Annotated[Literal["none", "committed", "rolled_back", "partial", "unknown"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
ResolvedOutcome = Annotated[Literal["committed", "rolled_back", "partial"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
StepStatus = Annotated[Literal["pending", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "skipped"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
RecoveryState = Annotated[
    Literal[
        "none", "retry_scheduled", "retryable", "needs_reauthorization", "needs_resolution", "exhausted", "resolved"
    ],
    ArrowType(pa.string()),
]
RunStatus = Annotated[
    Literal["pending", "running", "retry_wait", "succeeded", "skipped", "failed", "cancelled"], ArrowType(pa.string())
]
RunTriggerKind = Annotated[Literal["schedule", "manual", "test"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
RevisionKind = Annotated[Literal["edit", "agent", "restore", "import"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
RenderStatus = Annotated[Literal["queued", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
ReportTracking = Annotated[Literal["pinned", "published", "head"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
OutputFormat = Annotated[Literal["none", "arrow", "parquet", "csv"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
InlineMode = Annotated[Literal["none", "summary", "image", "table"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
TargetKind = Annotated[Literal["catalog", "host"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
LoadMode = Annotated[Literal["replace", "append", "merge", "snapshot"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
SchemaChangePolicy = Annotated[Literal["fail", "add_columns"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
TransactionMode = Annotated[Literal["single", "per_statement", "none"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
IncrementalKind = Annotated[Literal["none", "derived", "stored"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
HealthState = Annotated[Literal["healthy", "failing", "stale", "paused", "disabled", "new"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
AlertRuleState = Annotated[Literal["ok", "firing", "error", "disabled"], ArrowType(pa.string())]
AlertInstanceState = Annotated[
    Literal["pending", "firing", "resolving", "resolved", "superseded"], ArrowType(pa.string())
]
AlertEventKind = Annotated[
    Literal[
        "transition",
        "notification",
        "acknowledged",

        "unsnoozed",
        "subscribed",

        "rule_error",
        "rule_recovered",
        "superseded",
    ],
    ArrowType(pa.string()),
]
DelegationKind = Annotated[Literal["catalog", "service"], ArrowType(pa.string())]

# Copyright 2025, 2026 Query Farm LLC - https://query.farm

"""Shared reporting records.

These are importable protocol definitions, not a service implementation.
Behavior and worker policy are documented in docs/design/reporting-protocols/.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Annotated

import pyarrow as pa
from vgi_rpc import ArrowSerializableDataclass

from vgi.reporting._arrow import Instant, Json, non_null_list
from vgi.reporting._enums import (
    CredentialState,
    DelegationKind,
    DeliveryStatus,
    EffectOutcome,
    ExecutionState,
    LimitUnit,
    ParameterType,
    ParamKind,
    RecoveryState,
    ResolvedOutcome,
    RunStatus,
    RunTriggerKind,
    Severity,
    StepStatus,
    TriggerKind,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class PrincipalRef(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Historical or authenticated principal reference; labels are not authority."""

    id: str
    display_name: str
    email: str | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class OwnerRef(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Worker-resolved management identity: principal, group, project or workspace."""

    kind: str
    id: str
    display_name: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Ownership(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Management owner and durable parent, independent of execution credentials."""

    owner_ref: OwnerRef
    parent_owner_ref: OwnerRef | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class ResourceMeta(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Versioned ownership and attribution shared by persistent resources."""

    version: int
    ownership: Ownership
    created_at: Instant
    created_by: PrincipalRef
    updated_at: Instant
    updated_by: PrincipalRef
    allowed_actions: Annotated[list[str], non_null_list(pa.string())]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class OwnershipInput(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Creation-time ownership preferences; None asks the worker for its default."""

    owner_ref: OwnerRef | None = None
    parent_owner_ref: OwnerRef | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class ExecutionInput(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Creation/test execution identity; None selects the authenticated caller."""

    principal_id: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class ExecutionIdentity(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Resolved execution principal and its current readiness."""

    principal: PrincipalRef
    state: ExecutionState
    reason: str | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Ack(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Acknowledgement of an admitted mutation."""

    applied: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Limit(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Worker-chosen limit; None means unlimited and zero means zero."""

    name: str
    value: int | None
    unit: LimitUnit


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class ServiceInfo(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Common advertised protocol identity, writability and limits."""

    protocol_version: str
    display_name: str
    writable: bool
    limits: Annotated[list[Limit], non_null_list(pa.struct(Limit.ARROW_SCHEMA))]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class RetryPolicy(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Worker retry budgets and backoff bounds; attempts include the first dispatch."""

    max_attempts: int
    max_elapsed_seconds: int
    initial_backoff_seconds: int
    max_backoff_seconds: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class DataSource(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Non-secret session attachment reference with an explicit remote catalog."""

    alias: str
    attachment_id: str
    location: str
    catalog_name: str
    label: str = ""
    required: bool = True


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class DelegationKey(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Exact catalog attachment or standalone service credential key."""

    kind: DelegationKind
    location: str
    catalog_name: str
    attachment_id: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Delegation(DelegationKey):
    """Write-only grant and ticket; None expiry means unlimited."""

    grant: str
    ticket: str
    expires_at: Instant | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class DelegationWrite(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Compare-and-swap credential write; version zero requires an absent key."""

    delegation: Delegation
    expected_version: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class DelegationRecord(DelegationKey):
    """Readable delegation metadata; never includes a grant or ticket."""

    version: int
    expires_at: Instant | None
    updated_at: Instant


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class CredentialStatus(DelegationKey):
    """Readiness of one required delegation without its credentials."""

    state: CredentialState
    expires_at: Instant | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class ParameterOption(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """One display label and JSON scalar accepted by a select parameter."""

    label: str
    value_json: Json


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class ParameterSpec(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Public parameter type, default and allowed select values."""

    key: str
    label: str
    type: ParameterType
    required: bool = False
    default_json: Json = "null"
    options: Annotated[list[ParameterOption], non_null_list(pa.struct(ParameterOption.ARROW_SCHEMA))] = field(
        default_factory=list
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class ParamValue(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Tagged literal JSON or relative period; exactly one payload is present."""

    key: str
    kind: ParamKind
    json: Json | None = None
    relative: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class ReportRef(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Report service and ID, with an optional pinned revision."""

    service_url: str
    report_id: str
    revision_id: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Destination(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Channel kind and address interpreted by the notify worker."""

    kind: str
    address: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Field(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """A display label/value pair, also used for notification correlation entries."""

    label: str
    value: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Attachment(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Immutable attachment content and a service-fetchable download URL."""

    filename: str
    media_type: str
    url: str
    size_bytes: int
    sha256: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Artifact(Attachment):
    """Produced attachment with the expiry of its temporary URL."""

    expires_at: Instant | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Output(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Action output, optionally with a downloadable artifact and known row count."""

    artifact: Artifact | None
    media_type: str
    row_count: int | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class RunError(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Sanitized persisted error; canonical code and stable application kind."""

    code: str
    kind: str
    location: str | None
    message: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class DestinationResult(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """One destination outcome, including ambiguous provider acceptance."""

    destination: Destination
    status: DeliveryStatus
    reason: str | None
    message: str | None
    provider_reference: str | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Notification(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Portable message content with explicit attribution and correlation."""

    title: str
    summary: str
    body_markdown: str = ""
    link_url: str = ""
    link_label: str = ""
    fields: Annotated[list[Field], non_null_list(pa.struct(Field.ARROW_SCHEMA))] = field(default_factory=list)
    image: Attachment | None = None
    attachments: Annotated[list[Attachment], non_null_list(pa.struct(Attachment.ARROW_SCHEMA))] = field(
        default_factory=list
    )
    severity: Severity = "info"
    thread_key: str = ""
    on_behalf_of: PrincipalRef
    correlation: Annotated[list[Field], non_null_list(pa.struct(Field.ARROW_SCHEMA))] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Trigger(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Cron or once trigger; instants are aware UTC datetimes on the wire."""

    kind: TriggerKind
    cron: str | None = None
    run_at: Instant | None = None
    time_zone: str = "UTC"
    start_at: Instant | None = None
    end_at: Instant | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class TriggerPreview(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Deterministic fire instants and the worker time-zone database version."""

    fire_times: Annotated[list[Instant], non_null_list(pa.timestamp("us", "UTC"))]
    description: str
    warnings: Annotated[list[str], non_null_list(pa.string())]
    tzdb_version: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class StepAttempt(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Immutable observed attempt timing, effect outcome and failure."""

    attempt: int
    started_at: Instant
    finished_at: Instant | None
    effect_outcome: EffectOutcome
    error: RunError | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class RunStep(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Stable operation identity and persisted attempts for one execution step."""

    step_index: int
    operation_id: str
    kind: str
    status: StepStatus
    effect_outcome: EffectOutcome
    attempts: Annotated[list[StepAttempt], non_null_list(pa.struct(StepAttempt.ARROW_SCHEMA))]
    rows_affected: int | None
    receiver_reference: str | None
    deduplication_expires_at: Instant | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Recovery(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Current recovery state, retry timing and actions permitted for the caller."""

    state: RecoveryState
    failed_step_index: int | None
    next_retry_at: Instant | None
    attempts_remaining: int
    reason: str | None
    allowed_actions: Annotated[list[str], non_null_list(pa.string())]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class StepResolution(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Outcome and receipt/audit evidence to be verified by the worker."""

    step_index: int
    outcome: ResolvedOutcome
    evidence_ref: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class RecoveryEvent(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Audit record for an authorized recovery action."""

    occurred_at: Instant
    actor: PrincipalRef
    action: str
    note: str
    resolutions: Annotated[list[StepResolution], non_null_list(pa.struct(StepResolution.ARROW_SCHEMA))]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class Run(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Shared run snapshot, execution identity, outcomes and recovery history."""

    run_id: str
    version: int
    trigger_kind: RunTriggerKind
    scheduled_for: Instant
    admitted_at: Instant
    started_at: Instant | None
    finished_at: Instant | None
    status: RunStatus
    skip_reason: str | None
    execution_principal: PrincipalRef
    resource_version: int
    parameter_values: Annotated[list[ParamValue], non_null_list(pa.struct(ParamValue.ARROW_SCHEMA))]
    outputs: Annotated[list[Output], non_null_list(pa.struct(Output.ARROW_SCHEMA))]
    destination_results: Annotated[list[DestinationResult], non_null_list(pa.struct(DestinationResult.ARROW_SCHEMA))]
    steps: Annotated[list[RunStep], non_null_list(pa.struct(RunStep.ARROW_SCHEMA))]
    error: RunError | None
    recovery: Recovery
    recovery_events: Annotated[list[RecoveryEvent], non_null_list(pa.struct(RecoveryEvent.ARROW_SCHEMA))]
    allowed_actions: Annotated[list[str], non_null_list(pa.string())]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
class KeyValue(ArrowSerializableDataclass):
    """Lossless tagged scalar used by canonical alert keys and watermark JSON."""

    type: str
    value: str
